description: Read a page of the official docs, or one section of it, by URL or site path. Fetched live as Markdown from nuvemshop.dev or tiendanube.dev; other hosts are refused. Use it after search-docs, lookup-endpoint or when the user pastes a docs link.

locale.description: Docs language: en-US (default), pt-BR (Nuvemshop) or es (Tiendanube)

maxChars.description: Truncate the answer to this many characters (default 20000)

section.description: Heading or anchor of one section to return instead of the whole page

url.description: Page URL on nuvemshop.dev or tiendanube.dev (with or without .md, an #anchor selects a section), or a site path such as "api/resources/2025-03/order"

name: read-doc
title: Read a Tiendanube / Nuvemshop doc page
